captions.text: New evidence from royal seals reveals a forgotten female ruler who commanded ancient Egypt over 5000 years ago.
William Matthew Flinders Petrie excavated tomb Y at Abydos and believed he found a new king named Merneith.
Was she actually the daughter of Djer, the third king of the First Dynasty?
Scientific American reported on those newly analyzed royal seals that unveil Ancient Egypt's first female ruler.
Excavating tomb Y at Abydos, William Matthew Flinders Petrie uncovered 5000 years of history.
Merneith ruled ancient Egypt more than 5000 years ago.
